description: Get a link the person opens to ask WRDO for a quote, booking or order (optionally from one business). The person finishes in WRDO. This tool never books, charges or creates an account. It only starts a request: nothing is booked until the business confirms in WRDO. The result is a plain wa.me link with the request already typed in; it is not stored, has no token and does not expire. Nothing is sent or saved until the person opens it and sends the message. "what" is required; business_id is optional and must come from search_local_businesses (an unknown id returns an error).

business_id.description: A WRDO business id (lbiz_…), copied from the "id" of a search_local_businesses result. Ids are not guessable; an unknown id returns an error.

what.description: What the person needs: a kind of business or service ("plumber", "pizza") or a business name.

when.description: When they want it, in their words, e.g. "Saturday morning".

name: start_request
title: Start a request in WRDO
